en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Every time I come here, I play the
role of their "ideal." Like some shared fantasy.

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's fantasy...
I am prepared for total absurdity.
Hey, Shuichi...
Huh? What is it?

I got some fan-fuckin'-tastic news that'll put
a smile on your face!

Kehehe... And since we're childhood friends,
you're gettin' an exclusive inside scoop!
So you better feel real fuckin' special!
Ah, okay...

<CLT=cltMIND>I see, so we're childhood friends in her
fantasy. That's why she's being so nice to me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I should be nice to her too.
If I'm not careful, she might wake up...
So, yeah, about this news...

<CLT=cltMIND>...What's going on?
Why did she get quiet all of a sudden?
Y-Y-Y-Youuuuuu...
<CLT=cltMIND>...You...?

Y-You can...have your way with me...if you
want...
I can what?

You didn't hear me!?
You are SUCH an asshole!

I just said you could have your way with me!
You fuckin' asshole!

No, I *heard* you,
I just... I don't understand...
Huh!? Wh-Why?
I-It's just that, this is so sudden...
It's only cuz...I wanna...thank you, Shuichi...
Thank me...?
I-I mean, what better reward for a man...

than this slammin' sexy-ass body of mine,
know what I'm sayin'!?

...I'm going to ignore that last bit...
So, why do you want to thank me?

Huh? You really don't know!? And you call
yourself my childhood friend!?
I'm sorry, I...really don't know...
D-Don't laugh...okay?
Alright, I won't laugh.
You won't...shout at me?
Of course I won't. Don't worry.
O-Okay...

Ever since we were kids, Shuichi...you've
always taken care of me, y'know?

You held my hand everywhere we went...
You stayed by my side, no matter what...
And you're still doin' that for me...

You're the only one who sees past my act
and knows the real me, Shuichi...

<CLT=cltMIND>I see...we must be very
close in this fantasy...

If I didn't have you in my life...I'd prolly be
in a gutter or something...

You're the reason I can hold my head up
high as the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Inventor<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
A-And so...I wanted to thank you...

But you said...you didn't need my inventions...
That I should use them to help people...

So I don't have anything else to offer you
as thanks except...m-myself...

<CLT=cltMIND>Miu's sentences sputtered out, half-spoken.
Her face was cherry red.

No, that's just an excuse...
Wh-What I really want is...
...your baby.
You want my *child*!?!?!?
W-Well...

What the hell's so hard to understand!?
God, you're so fuckin' embarrassing!

With my beauty, brains, and talent, and your
winning personality...

Why, that's the recipe for the perfect child!
Hah-haaaa! Best of both worlds, baby!

We just gotta give the kid the right education,
let 'em invent whatever, and we're set for life!

Wh-What is it...? Are you gonna fuck up
my perfect plans for our future?
Or...is it...
you don't...want that future with me?

You won't let me be your girlfriend, Shuichi?
C-Cuz you don't need me, is that it?

N-No! I don't want you to abandon me, too!
S-So we...we gotta make a baby!
Ah, um...

I have to make sure you won't abandon me!
This is the only way!
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that...how she truly feels?

C'mon, please...? I...want you...
I...need you inside me, Shuichi.
Okay? That's okay, right? Please?

O-Of course not!
There's no way I could do that!

You motherfucker! If you're not gonna use
that dick of yours now, then when huh!?

You know what, fuck it! C'mere, Shuichi!
I'm gonna squeeze every last drop outta you!
Huh!? W-Wait a minute!
<CLT=cltMIND>.........
<CLT=cltMIND>......
<CLT=cltMIND>...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've acquired a new theme, "Love Suite."
